checks.details: All 1679 frozen source-file hashes, 40 package files, supplied intake/inventory/verification/build/handoff records, rebuilt oracle manifest and all 11 native artifacts verified before/after. Oracle bundle recomputed from source-v2; context bundle and 9 native build inputs unchanged. Original security report and every historical private file/symlink inventory remain unchanged.

Reviewed the full package diff and actual v2 code. History is bounded to one scalar summary and one cut; state is committed only after validation. Failures cannot receive closure credit even when a HELD response passed client checks but failed observer ordinal matching. No authentication, source, profile or process-generation gate was relaxed.

Four independent final-write-boundary start probes advanced the oracle poll beyond target, observer, oracle and context-lease deadlines; each wrote zero G bytes and cleared all 3 cached admissions. Live start wrote G. Expired oracle operation after resume poll wrote zero R bytes; live resume wrote R. No inspection on the short dispatch path. These use synthetic clock/descriptors and the actual guard/stream methods.
